summary: Full backend + frontend validation of the Graduation Journey & Build My Blueprint™ Doorway. Backend: pytest tests/test_journey.py → 9/9 passed (default state, welcome-seen persistence, interest 400 before graduation, transition/view silent no-op, admin list 403 for participant / 200 for super_admin, full graduate→view→interest(interested/not_now)→revoke flow, duplicate graduate 400, unknown user 404, self-graduate 403, milestone add/remove). Frontend (Playwright, owner account): login → dashboard renders one-time WelcomeModal ('You have a plan. Now you get to build it.') and dismisses via journey-welcome-begin; JourneyStrip renders all 5 stages (enter/build/graduate/unlock/expand) with key SVG; sidebar shows nav-journey and nav-admin-journey; /app/journey shows locked BMB door + evidence tiles (Blueprint/Assessments/Employment/Digital) + recognized milestones and NO celebration card while ungraduated. /staff/journey lists participants with stage badge + search, detail modal opens, milestone add persists, Approve graduation flips to Revoke state, dashboard then shows dash-graduation-card and /app/journey hero flips to 'You built the key.' with 'Graduated 8/25/2026' badge. TransitionPage shows 3 info cards + 'what you should know' checklist + single outbound <a href=https://buildmyblueprintbbc.com target=_blank rel=noopener noreferrer> (data-testid=transition-bmb-link) — no auto-redirect, no checkout, no enrollment. 'I'm interested' and 'Not right now' both record with toast + 'Currently recorded' echo. Milestone removal and graduation revoke both work (native confirm accepted). All 11 core routes smoke-loaded without blank screens. Owner account left NON-graduated (stage=build, graduation_approved=false, TEST_QA milestone cleaned up).

issues: 'Revoke graduation' and milestone 'Remove' use native window.confirm() instead of a shadcn AlertDialog — inconsistent with the rest of the UI and auto-dismissed by automation (initially made revoke appear to fail). Recommend AlertDialog.
DialogContent has no DialogTitle → Radix a11y console warning ('DialogContent requires a DialogTitle'). Wrap the headline in DialogTitle or VisuallyHidden.
Stage carousel is horizontally scrollable (intentional snap-x) but at 1920px the 4th/5th cards are clipped with no visible scroll affordance/arrow — users may not realise Unlock/Expand exist. Minor.

action_items: Optional: replace window.confirm in AdminJourney (revoke + milestone remove) with shadcn AlertDialog
Optional: add DialogTitle (or VisuallyHidden) to WelcomeModal to clear a11y warning
Optional: add scroll affordance/arrows to JourneyStrip on desktop
critical_code_review_comments: journey.py: revoke-graduation intentionally keeps transition_viewed / interested_in_continuing as history — verified stage falls back correctly (build/enter), but the stale interest is still shown in the admin modal ('Decision: ...') after revoke; consider labelling it 'previous decision'.
No 'Coming Soon' placeholders in the journey feature. The only 'coming soon' strings are pre-existing video notes in lib/doorways.js (content annotations, not empty doors).
Only journey outbound BMB reference is the plain anchor in TransitionPage; Landing.jsx footer/utility links to buildmyblueprintbbc.com are pre-existing marketing links, no redirect logic anywhere.
seed_data_creation: Throwaway journey_*@example.com participants created by pytest; TEST_QA Milestone added and removed on owner account. Owner left ungraduated with welcome_seen=true.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Owner uid = user_474b88fe68cb4a89. Helper script /app/backend/tests/_work/owner_state.py [show|revoke|unseen] prints/mutates owner journey state (use 'unseen' to re-trigger the welcome modal, 'revoke' to un-graduate). Admin revoke/milestone-remove use native confirm() — Playwright must register page.on('dialog', d.accept()).
rca_of_the_issue: Initial apparent failures were test-harness artifacts: (1) dashboard graduation card testid is 'dash-graduation-card' not 'graduation-celebration'; (2) revoke appeared to fail because Playwright auto-dismisses window.confirm. Both re-verified passing after harness fixes; no product defects found.
